items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 29 October 2026 at 4:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in west.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over the near continent and deep area of low pressure near Greenland.


##Wind##

Southerly or southeasterly 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, although remaining slight in the southeast.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 to 5, beginning to veer south or southwest 3 or 4 Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, small risk of mist in the east Friday night.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, risk of poor in the east Friday night.
